decisions.reason: Matching the reference lettering and mixing in B-roll do not change the existing clean-editing, effects, or transition rules.
The full-lesson clause restates the existing requirement to capture a complete lesson rather than an incomplete fragment.
The candidate already requires the current batch to combine Teyron's long-form videos with client-provided B-roll.
Requiring a complete lesson concerns moment completeness, not the separate standard for selecting strong or impactful moments.
The current 45-to-60-second range already excludes a 30-second clip, and the source does not establish a different duration range.
The source gives production corrections for lettering, lesson completeness, and B-roll without changing the qualification method or success gate.
The clip-format corrections do not change the Lead Clipper pathway, compensation, training focus, or responsibilities.
Requesting corrections does not change who approves clips, which clips may be published, or how rejected clips are handled.
The source does not change the monthly approved-clip count, counting rule, cadence, or deferred lifecycle status.
The source changes clip-content presentation but does not alter approval-dependent publishing, destination, or the current publication schedule.
The source contains no change to the submission channel, folder configuration, batch size, deadline, or planned Notion workflow.
